preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 668.
The length of the permutation n must be between 2 and 100.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= p_i <= n for p_i in p)
preconditions.description: Each element in the permutation p must be a distinct integer from 1 to n.

postconditions.description: The output permutation p' must have the same length n as the input permutation p.
The output permutation p' must be different from the input permutation p.

postconditions.expression: sorted([p_prime[i] + p_prime[i+1] for i in range(n-1)]) == sorted([p[i] + p[i+1] for i in range(n-1)])
postconditions.description: The fingerprint of the output permutation p' must be equal to the fingerprint of the input permutation p.
